sources.prompt_text: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: original raster illustration for a 1926–1941 Chinese military strategy game's development menu. Create a single wide landscape scene, approximately 2.4:1. Strong, serious, weathered battlefield-era oil-painted realism, tangible aged iron, dust, brick and soil; crisp readable silhouettes suitable for a small 384x160 runtime image. Earth brown, dark iron, sandstone, muted oxblood accents and warm old-gold highlights, no green palette, no pale washed-out look. Diffuse overcast illumination, restrained contrast, substantial worn materials. Composition: primary action and objects clearly readable in the central 80%; keep the bottom 20% quiet for a separately drawn game label. Full image bleed to edges. No text, numbers, lettering, UI, frame, border, logos, flags, watermarks, modern objects or fantasy elements. This is a new original illustration, do not copy any existing game's artwork. Subject: reclaiming farmland in rural China during the 1920s–1930s. Two small period-clothed farm workers operating a traditional wooden plough with an ox, dark freshly turned earth in the foreground, terraced dry fields, mature ochre grain and a simple worn earth-walled farmhouse in the distance. Convey hard practical labor and rebuilding, with brown soil and gold grain rather than lush green vegetation.
